name: Local git
description: Check a card's branch out in the project folder, so you can run it from your usual checkout. Refuses when the project folder has uncommitted changes.

commands.title: Check out in project folder
commands.description: Switch the project folder to the card's branch. "detach" works while the card's worktree holds the branch; "branch" needs no worktree to hold it.

mode.title: How
mode.description: detach: the branch's commit, detached (always possible). branch: the branch itself (only when no worktree has it checked out).

run.exec: p=${project.path}; b=${card.branch}; case "$b" in -*) echo "refusing: branch name $b looks like an option" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; git -C "$p" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "$p is not a git checkout" >&2; exit 1; }; if [ -n "$(git -C "$p" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" ]; then echo "refusing: $p has uncommitted changes. Commit or stash them there first:" >&2; git -C "$p" status --short --untracked-files=no >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ "$BC_INPUT_MODE" = branch ]; then top=$(git -C "$p" rev-parse --show-toplevel); holder=$(git -C "$p" worktree list --porcelain | awk -v ref="refs/heads/$b" 'substr($0,1,9)=="worktree " {w=substr($0,10)} $0=="branch " ref {print w}'); if [ "$holder" = "$top" ]; then echo "$p is already on $b"; exit 0; fi; if [ -n "$holder" ]; then echo "refusing: $b is checked out in the worktree $holder, and git lets one branch be checked out in only one place. Use How = detach to get the same commit here, or remove that worktree first." >&2; exit 1; fi; git -C "$p" switch "$b" && echo "$p is on $b"; else git -C "$p" switch --detach "$b" && echo "$p is at $b ($(git -C "$p" rev-parse --short HEAD), detached)"; fi
